# WebCrew

> WebCrew is an AI receptionist and AI front desk for local service businesses in the United States (HVAC, plumbing, roofing, electrical, cleaning, contractors, salons, spas, auto services). It answers phone calls and website chats 24/7, books jobs into the owner's Google Calendar, follows up with leads, and asks happy customers for Google reviews. Setup is $0 and every plan starts with a 30-day free trial.

## What WebCrew does
- **AI receptionist (phone):** answers your business line 24/7 with a natural voice. It answers questions from your own business info (services, hours, service area), takes the caller's name, number and what they need, and flags urgent calls.
- **Emergency handling:** urgent calls (no heat, active leak, power out) are flagged and can be transferred to the owner's cell.
- **Appointment booking:** with Google Calendar connected, it books, reschedules and cancels appointments. Customers can reply C / R / X by text to confirm, reschedule or cancel.
- **Call summaries:** the owner gets a summary after every real customer call.
- **Missed-call text back:** texts callers who agreed to receive texts.
- **Lead follow-up:** day-3 and day-10 follow-ups for leads that did not book.
- **Review requests:** sends customers the business's Google review link after a visit. No review gating.
- **Website:** a free preview of a new website, or an AI assistant added to the owner's existing website that can talk and chat with visitors.
- **Monthly report:** calls handled, after-hours calls, leads, bookings and follow-ups.

## Pricing (October 2026)
- **Founding 10:** $99/month, locked for life, for the first 10 clients. 250 AI minutes, 300 texts, 1,000 website chats a month.
- **Standard:** $149/month after the founding spots fill. 500 AI minutes, 300 texts, 1,000 website chats a month.
- **Custom:** quote for multiple locations or high call volume.
- $0 setup. 30-day free trial. No contract, cancel anytime.
- No overage charges: if minutes run out, calls ring the owner's cell until the month resets.
- Full details: https://webcrew.app/pricing

## How it works
1. The owner tells us about the business (or pastes their website). We build a free preview.
2. The owner test-calls the AI and reviews everything.
3. The owner forwards their existing business number to the AI (they keep their number).
4. The AI answers from then on. Nothing goes live until the owner approves it.

## Key facts
- Founded 2026. United States only. English.
- Voice AI: Google Gemini (native audio). Calendar: Google Calendar. Phone and texts: Twilio.
- Early stage: onboarding founding clients now. WebCrew does not publish customer counts or results yet.
- WebCrew does not claim HIPAA or SOC 2 compliance.
- Try the live demo line: +1 (918) 255-5151.
